Kuvitus: polkupyörä seisoo kuumalla asfa: Illustration: a bicycle stands on hot asphalt in the summer heat. The sun is shining, heat shimmers above the asphalt, and the red column of the thermometer on the post is high.
Kuvitus: sama polkupyörä lumisena pakkas: Illustration: the same bicycle on a snowy frosty morning. There is snow on the ground and on the saddle, and the column of the thermometer on the post is low.
Periaatekuva, ei mittakaavassa: kaasua s: Principle diagram, not to scale: gas in a cylinder whose upper end is closed by a movable piston. The gas is a thermodynamic system; its boundary is drawn as a dashed line around the gas. The walls of the cylinder, the piston and the rest of the world are the surroundings. The state variables that describe the state of the system are pressure p, volume V and temperature T.
Kaaviokuva kaasun mikromallista: kaksi s: Schematic diagram of the micro model of a gas: two closed containers of the same size with the same number of particles. In the cold gas the arrows showing speed are short, in the hot gas they are long, and the pressure p2 of the hot gas is greater than the pressure p1 of the cold gas.
Kelvinasteikko ja celsiusasteikko rinnak: The Kelvin scale and the Celsius scale side by side to scale: 0 K is −273.15 °C (absolute zero), 273.15 K is 0 °C (water freezes) and 373.15 K is 100 °C (water boils). The intervals of the scales are the same size, and you get the reading in kelvins by adding 273.15 to the Celsius reading.
Kaasun paine lämpötilan funktiona suljet: Pressure of a gas as a function of temperature in a closed container: the data points in the temperature range 0–100 °C lie on a straight line, and the extrapolated line meets zero pressure at a temperature of about −270 °C. The vertical axis is at the left edge of the figure at −300 °C.
